subject: Re: Redwood x Amply: Partner Showcase & Field Learning Series — scope and logistics
messages:
From: Amy Lin <amy@amply.ai>
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: partners@amply.ai
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood x Amply — Partner Showcase concept and ask

Hi Aisha,

Hope you’re well — I’m Amy on partnerships at Amply (we build an embeddings-powered recommendations layer for commerce). We loved Redwood’s recent latency benchmarks and think there’s a strong joint story for product teams building recommender systems.

High-level idea: a 45-minute joint webinar + 1 customer panel (30 min demo + 15 min panel + 15 min Q&A), plus a follow-up co-authored blog and customer case highlight. Objective: generate 250–400 MQLs across both companies and capture 2–3 qualified PoC leads.

What we need from Redwood:
- a short technical demo (20–30 min) showing inference cost/latency wins for retrieval-augmented flows
- one customer who can speak on production benefits (we can share 1 customer intro)
- co-marketing assets (emails, social, 1-page landing)

I attached our sponsor + logistics pack with suggested dates, promotion windows, and a nominal co-sponsorship split for paid promotion. Can you let me know if this is something Redwood would be interested in piloting in April/May?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call this week to align.

Best,
Amy Lin
Head of Partnerships, Amply
amy@amply.ai
attachments: amply-sponsor-package-v2.pdf
From: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
To: Amy Lin <amy@amply.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x Amply — Partner Showcase concept and ask

Hi Amy — great to meet you over email, and thanks for the clear package. Amply’s use case aligns well with a lot of inbound signals we’re seeing from commerce customers. We’re interested.

Quick answers and asks:
- Timing: April looks tight for us because of a product launch; would May 18–25 window work for Amply?
- Audience: we should target platform/infra leads (SRE/Platform) + ML engineers — please confirm your target titles so we can tailor the landing copy.
- Customer panel: if you can introduce a customer, that helps a lot. If not, we have a candidate at Lumina Analytics who can speak to inference cost savings.
- MOU + commercial: can we get a short MOU and the rough co-sponsorship numbers? Ben, can you review budget and sponsorship split? Marissa, can you handle promotion timeline and speaker ops?

I’ve looped Ben and Marissa to cover commercial & ops, and copied Karthik for integration-focused content suggestions (we may want a short joint code sample repo).

If useful, we can do a 30-min alignment call Wed. 3pm PT.

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-speaker-bios.csv
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: aisha_rahman@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Amy Lin <amy@amply.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x Amply — sponsorship / commercial terms

Aisha / Amy — quick note on commercials from my side.

We can cover 40% of paid promotion up to $6k for the initial event. If Amply covers 60% we’ll split creative and amplification duties 50/50 across our paid channels and email lists. For a package that includes the co-authored blog and customer highlight, we’d treat that as part of the same initiative and use the same attribution window.

If Amply wants a discount for committing to a 3-event mini-series, we can offer a 15% reduction and priority slotting for product engineers to present.

I’ll get a short MOU drafted and send to Amy for signature. I’ll attach the draft and DocuSign link once it’s ready.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Field Marketing, Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-amply-mou-draft.docx
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Amy Lin <amy@amply.ai>, aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x Amply — promotion plan & ops checklist

Thanks — I put together an initial ops checklist and a proposed promotion timeline. High-level:

- Week -5: Confirm date & MOU signed; share landing copy and speaker bios
- Week -4: Landing page + registration live; social creative draft (shared folder)
- Week -3: Email blast #1 (both lists) + organic social push
- Week -1: Reminder emails + speaker rehearsal + final slide decks
- Post: Publish co-authored blog + gated case study; paid social boost for 2 weeks

Ops asks from Amply: speaker bios (headshot/title/one-line), 2–3 social captions, and any customer commitments for the panel. We’ll handle registration and recording.

I added Michael Torres at Brightline Consulting in case we want a neutral moderator for the panel — he’s done these before and can be hired at a modest fee. Amy, please let me know if you want me to reach out to Michael.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Alliances & Events, Redwood Inference
attachments: (none)
From: Amy Lin <amy@amply.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aisha_rahman@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 6 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood x Amply — final confirmation and docs

Thanks everyone — happy to proceed. A few quick confirmations:
- Dates: May 19 (preferred) — please hold that date and I’ll coordinate with our customer.
- Panel: Amply will introduce a customer (Brightline Consulting is the ops partner; Michael Torres can moderate).
- Commercial: Amply accepts the 60/40 split and is interested in the 3-event discount conversation.
- Assets: attaching the signed sponsor package and a filled speaker-bio CSV. I also uploaded the draft MOU to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/signed/amply-mou-2027

Looking forward to the Wed call to lock speaker names and demo scope.

Best,
Amy Lin
Head of Partnerships, Amply
